foundations.title: Foundations & Principles
foundations.intro: Ngelmak is built on a set of sacred, non-negotiable principles that ensure the project's fidelity to its original vision. These foundations define our identity and protect the space from any commercial, political, or ideological drift.

free.title: Absolute Free Access
free.text: All services offered by Ngelmak will always remain free. No premium features, no commissions, no subscriptions will ever be introduced. Free access is an ethical commitment, not a commercial argument.

noProfit.title: Total Absence of Profit Motive
noProfit.text: Ngelmak is not a company. No intrusive advertising, no data selling, no partnerships contrary to our values will be tolerated. The project is a common good, not a product.

dataProtection.title: Strict Data Protection
dataProtection.text: User data will never be sold, shared, or exploited by third parties. Confidentiality and security are absolute commitments, upheld at every stage of the project's development and operation.

communityGovernance.title: Community Governance
communityGovernance.text: Major decisions involve the community. The founder protects the vision, contributors enhance the tool, and the community guides its evolution. Ngelmak belongs to those who keep it alive.

transparency.title: Total Transparency
transparency.text: All decisions, technical developments, and financial contributions will be documented and accessible. Nothing will be hidden. Transparency is an essential pillar of trust and long-term sustainability.

governance.title: Governance & Rights
governance.intro: Ngelmak's governance is based on a clear balance between protecting the founding vision, community participation, and transparency. Each actor plays an essential role in the project's stability and integrity.

founder.title: The Founder
founder.text: The founder holds the initial rights and ensures the coherence of the project. They protect the sacred principles, validate strategic directions, and ensure that Ngelmak is never diverted from its objectives.

contributors.title: Contributors
contributors.text: Contributors participate in development, writing, design, and improvement of the project. Their work is essential, but it always aligns with the founding principles.

community.title: The Community
community.text: The community occupies a central place. It proposes ideas, participates in decisions, reports issues, and contributes to collective reflection. Ngelmak belongs to those who use it.

strategicDecisions.title: Strategic Decisions
strategicDecisions.text: Any decision likely to affect the project's identity — sacred principles, economic model, governance — requires community consultation and founder validation. This mechanism protects Ngelmak from any drift or attempt at appropriation.

intro.p1: Information sharing is the first functional module of Ngelmak. It allows members to publish analyses, reflections, testimonies, or teachings in a responsible and structured environment. The goal is not to produce content for visibility, but to contribute to a collective understanding of our realities.
intro.p2: Each publication must follow a rigorous, respectful, and publicly useful approach. Information sharing is a civic act: it commits the author and enriches the community.

post.title: The Post: Central Unit of Expression
post.text: The Post is the main form of expression on Ngelmak. It may be an analysis, an in-depth commentary, a testimony, or a personal reflection. It must present a clear intention, a minimal structure, and added value for the community.
post.list2: Context allowing the reader to understand the scope of the statement.
post.list3: A contribution oriented toward the collective interest.

encouraged.title: What Is Encouraged
encouraged.text: The module values content that enlightens, explains, or enriches reflection. Analyses, experience feedback, summaries, constructive criticism, and educational contributions are particularly appreciated.

forbidden.title: What Is Forbidden
forbidden.text: To preserve the quality of the space, certain content is not allowed. This includes personal attacks, provocations, staged content without public utility, or publications lacking context or reflection.
forbidden.list3: Raw reposts without analysis or added value.
forbidden.list4: Private information about a third party.

comments.title: Comments
comments.text: Comments extend the dialogue. They must be reasoned, respectful, and oriented toward understanding. They are not impulsive reactions but contributions intended to enrich the discussion.

intro.p1: The Mobility module will be the second major service of Ngelmak. Its goal is to facilitate travel between community members in a spirit of solidarity, responsibility, and sovereignty. Unlike commercial platforms, this service will be entirely free, with no commissions and no data exploitation.
intro.p2: The idea is simple: allow a driver to offer a trip, and a traveler to request one, while ensuring a safe, transparent, and respectful environment. This module aligns with Ngelmak's values: mutual aid, trust, and the common good.

sovereignAlternative.title: A Sovereign Alternative
sovereignAlternative.text: Current mobility platforms rely on opaque commercial models, high commissions, and massive collection of personal data. Ngelmak offers a sovereign, independent, and non-profit alternative designed to meet real user needs without turning them into products.

plannedFunctioning.title: Planned Functioning
plannedFunctioning.list1: A driver will be able to publish a trip with a departure point, destination, and schedule.
plannedFunctioning.list2: A traveler will be able to request a ride or join an existing trip.
plannedFunctioning.list3: Exchanges will take place in a secure and transparent environment.
plannedFunctioning.list4: No financial transaction will be integrated into the platform.
plannedFunctioning.afterList: The module will be deployed progressively to ensure its reliability and alignment with community needs.

trustBasedService.title: A Trust-Based Service
trustBasedService.text: Mobility relies on mutual trust. Members will be able to evaluate their experience, report potential issues, and contribute to continuous improvement of the service. The community will play a central role in regulating and ensuring the quality of the module.

vision.title: Vision & Objectives
vision.intro: Ngelmak was born from a simple but essential observation: Africa does not have a sovereign digital space where its peoples can communicate freely, analyze their realities, and build their own narrative without depending on foreign platforms. Our vision is to build a durable, credible tool deeply rooted in the collective interest.

geopoliticalContext.title: Geopolitical Context
geopoliticalContext.text: Dominant platforms shape the world's perception of Africa, filter African voices, and impose narratives that are often distorted or hostile. This structural dependence deprives Africans of a space to document their experiences, protect their collective memory, and assert their intellectual sovereignty.

whyNgelmak.title: Why Ngelmak
whyNgelmak.text: Faced with this strategic void, Ngelmak offers a sovereign alternative built by Africans and for Africans. The project aims to provide a responsible, rigorous space for expression oriented toward collective understanding rather than visibility.

objectives.title: Our Objectives
objectives.list1: Create a sovereign, free, and ethical digital space.
objectives.list2: Promote analysis, reflection, and constructive debate.
objectives.list3: Enable Africans to reclaim control of their narrative.
objectives.list4: Protect collective memory and lived experiences.
objectives.list5: Build a durable, transparent, and non-profit community tool.

roadmap.title: Roadmap

intro.p2: Ngelmak is a community-driven project built on transparency, accountability, and listening. Your contribution, whatever it may be, helps improve the space and strengthen our collective approach.

about.title: About Ngelmak
about.intro1: Ngelmak is a pan-African project dedicated to creating a sovereign, free, and ethical digital space. It addresses a fundamental need: enabling Africans to communicate, analyze, debate, and build their own narrative without relying on foreign platforms that filter their voices or impose their narratives.
about.intro2: The name Ngelmak, which means “courtyard” in Serer, refers to the traditional space where people gather to exchange, reflect, and make decisions together. This is precisely the role the project aims to restore to our digital space: a place of free expression, collective responsibility, and intellectual sovereignty.
about.why.title: Why Ngelmak Exists
about.why.text1: Africa evolves within an informational landscape dominated by foreign platforms that shape the perception of our realities. This dependency deprives Africans of a space to document their experiences, protect their collective memory, and assert their sovereignty. Narratives about us are often distorted, filtered, or instrumentalized.
about.why.text2: Faced with this strategic void, Ngelmak offers a credible, sustainable, and independent alternative, built by Africans and for Africans. The project aims to provide a space for responsible, rigorous expression oriented toward the common good.
about.vision.title: Our Vision
about.vision.text1: Ngelmak is rooted in a pan-African vision based on unity, dignity, and intellectual sovereignty. Despite our linguistic, cultural, or ideological differences, we share a common condition: being perceived from the outside through reductive or dehumanizing narratives.
about.vision.text2: The project aims to enable Africans to regain control over their voice, their image, and their history, while fully participating in international discussions with their own analyses and perspectives.
about.building.title: What We Are Building
about.building.text1: Ngelmak is not a commercial company but a community tool founded on solidarity, responsibility, and the common good. The project will evolve gradually, starting with modest but essential features, and will grow over time thanks to community contributions.
about.building.text2: The project is built on sacred principles: absolute free access, complete absence of profit motives, strict data protection, transparency, and community governance. These foundations ensure that Ngelmak remains a free, ethical, and sovereign space.
about.collective.title: A Collective Initiative
about.collective.text1: Although the founder holds the initial rights and safeguards the vision, Ngelmak belongs to its community. Users can propose ideas, contribute to development, participate in decisions, and help shape the future of the project.
about.collective.text2: Ngelmak is an initiative built with rigor, conviction, and responsibility, designed to sustainably serve the interests of Africans and all who share this vision.

community.title: Community
community.intro1: The community is the living heart of Ngelmak. It brings together people who wish to reflect, share, analyze, and contribute to the construction of a sovereign, free, and responsible digital space. Each member plays an essential role in the quality of exchanges and in the evolution of the project.
community.intro2: Unlike traditional platforms focused on visibility or competition, Ngelmak values contribution, rigor, and responsibility. The community is not a passive audience: it actively participates in moderation, governance, decision-making, and the continuous improvement of the space.
community.role.title: Role of the Community
community.role.text: Members can propose ideas, report harmful behavior, participate in discussions, contribute to development, and help maintain a healthy environment. Their involvement ensures that Ngelmak remains a collective space, built by and for its users.
community.role.list1: Participate in debates and enrich discussions.
community.role.list2: Contribute to the quality of exchanges through thoughtful analysis.
community.role.list3: Report behaviors that go against the principles of the project.
community.role.list5: Take part in community decisions when necessary.
community.sovereign.title: A Sovereign Community
community.sovereign.text1: Ngelmak belongs to its community. The project does not depend on any company, institution, or external actor. This independence ensures that decisions are made in the collective interest, without commercial or political pressure.
community.sovereign.text2: Every member, regardless of background or origin, can contribute to building a sovereign, ethical, and sustainable African digital space. The community is the force that allows the project to exist, grow stronger, and evolve.

donations.title: Support Ngelmak
donations.intro1: Ngelmak is a completely free, independent, and non-profit project. Donations help cover essential technical costs and ensure that the platform remains sovereign, ethical, and free from outside influence.
donations.intro2: Contributing is a voluntary act. Every donation, regardless of its amount, helps strengthen a digital African space built by and for its community.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.intro1: Moderation on Ngelmak is based on a clear ethic: protecting the dignity of members, ensuring the quality of exchanges, and preserving a space for responsible expression. It is never intended to censor ideas, but to maintain an atmosphere of respect, rigor, and constructive reflection.
moderation.intro2: Moderators intervene only when the fundamental principles of the project are threatened: personal attacks, malicious behavior, violations of essential rules, or deliberate degradation of the debate. Their role is to support the community, not control it.
moderation.principles.title: Principles of Moderation
moderation.principles.list1: Absolute respect for the dignity of every member.
moderation.principles.list2: Neutrality and absence of ideological judgment.
moderation.service: Moderation is a service provided to the community. It protects the space, encourages responsibility, and ensures that Ngelmak remains a place of collective reflection and intellectual sovereignty.

policies.title: Policies & Commitments
policies.intro: Ngelmak's policies are based on sacred, intangible, and non-negotiable principles. They ensure the protection of users, the sovereignty of the project, and fidelity to its founding vision. These commitments define what Ngelmak is, what it protects, and what it refuses to become.
policies.free.title: Absolute Free Access
policies.free.text1: All services offered by Ngelmak will always remain free, without exception. No feature will be paid, no commission will be taken, and no access will be conditioned by a subscription or payment.
policies.free.text2: Free access is not a commercial argument, but a fundamental ethical commitment ensuring that the platform remains a common good accessible to all.
policies.nonprofit.title: Total Absence of Profit Motive
policies.nonprofit.text1: Ngelmak is not intended to generate revenue, attract investors, or become a lucrative company. It is a community tool designed to meet collective needs, not to serve private interests.
policies.nonprofit.text2: No intrusive advertising, no data selling, and no commercial partnership contrary to the project's values will ever be implemented. Ngelmak is and will remain non-profit.
policies.data.title: Strict Data Protection
policies.data.text1: No data will be sold, shared, or exploited by third parties in any form. Information entrusted by users will not be exchanged or used for commercial, political, or advertising purposes.
policies.data.text2: Confidentiality and data security are absolute commitments, respected at every stage of the project's development, operation, and evolution.
policies.transparency.title: Total Transparency
policies.transparency.text1: All major decisions, technical evolutions, strategic orientations, and governance choices will be documented and accessible to all. This transparency also applies to the use of donations, which will be subject to clear, public, and verifiable tracking.
policies.transparency.text2: Nothing related to the functioning, financing, or future of the project will be hidden or decided in the shadows. Transparency is an essential pillar of trust and long-term sustainability.
policies.governance.title: Rights & Governance
policies.governance.text1: The founder holds the initial copyright and ensures the protection of the vision. The project is published under a GNU-type open-source license, ensuring that the code remains free, accessible, and modifiable by all.
policies.governance.text2: Governance is based on three levels: the founder, the contributors, and the community. No major change can be adopted without community consultation and validation by the founder.
policies.governance.text3: Strategic decisions — modification of sacred principles, introduction of paid services, license changes, privatization, or any evolution likely to divert the project — are strictly regulated and require a rigorous validation process.
policies.commitment.title: Commitment to the Community
policies.commitment.text1: Ngelmak belongs to those who use it. The community can propose ideas, vote on certain orientations, report issues, and contribute to the evolution of the project.
policies.commitment.text2: Ngelmak's policies are designed to protect this shared space, ensure its integrity, and guarantee its continuity in alignment with its founding values.

reports.title: Reporting
reports.intro1: The reporting system allows the community to protect the quality of the expression space. It is not used to censor opinions, but to identify harmful behaviors or actions that go against Ngelmak's fundamental principles.
reports.intro2: In an environment built on responsibility and rigor, reporting is a civic tool. It helps maintain a climate of respect, dignity, and constructive reflection for all members.
reports.what.title: What Can Be Reported
reports.what.text: Reports concern only behaviors that harm the quality of the debate or undermine the dignity of others. They must never be used to challenge a different opinion or analysis.
reports.what.list1: Personal attacks, insults, or degrading remarks.
reports.what.list3: Violations of the project's sacred principles.
reports.what.list5: Publication of private or sensitive information.
reports.process.title: Process and Transparency
reports.process.text: When content is reported, it is reviewed according to clear and public criteria. Some reports may be made visible to ensure transparency and prevent abuse. The goal is to protect the space, not to impose arbitrary sanctions.
reports.appeal.title: Appeal
reports.appeal.text: Any user may request a review if they believe a report or decision concerning them is unjustified. Appeals are an integral part of the process and ensure fairness within the system.
